title: Backlog: proven skips for barrels, and no citations needed for imports in new files
body:
**Intent:** maintainer dogfood feedback on [#21](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/21). Its tour spent a stop on `apps/server/src/evals.ts`, which is only re-exports. The fact worth knowing was the new `@docent/server/evals` entry point, not the 21 lines.

**Behavior change:** none. Adds "re-export-only changes" to the proven skips in backlog item 6. A script checks from the syntax that every changed line is an `export … from`, and the map stop names the new entry point in a sentence.

**Tier 0:** `backlog/` only.

**Known gaps:** none.
